purpose: Stage 8 deliverable (2026-09-06 continuation pass): a diagnostic, read-only mapping of all 133 governed Unit 202 learning points against the existing, older learner-facing runtime corpus (scripts/content/data assertions and lessons, apps/mobile diagram components, instructional visual assets). The governed 133-point curriculum is the source of truth; the runtime corpus is evaluated against it, not the reverse. This mapping does NOT re-author any lesson, storyboard, assertion, or question -- it scopes the remaining production delta only.
method: Six independent research agents, one per batch, each read every learning point in that batch's LEARNING-POINTS.json in full and searched the live runtime corpus (scripts/content/data/*.ts, apps/mobile/src/lib/proving-content, apps/mobile/src/components/diagrams, reports/instructional-visuals/semantic-audit.json and premium-artwork/proof/) for matching, missing, wrong-depth, obsolete, or unvisualised content.

categoryDefinitions.MAPPED_CORRECT: A runtime lesson/assertion/question genuinely and correctly teaches/tests this LP at the right depth.
categoryDefinitions.MAPPED_WRONG_DEPTH: Runtime content addresses the topic but at the wrong depth (too shallow, too deep/scope-creep, or an explicitly-excluded elaboration).
categoryDefinitions.MISSING_FROM_LESSONS: No runtime lesson content addresses this LP at all (a knowledge-graph assertion may exist as an unused prerequisite node).
categoryDefinitions.MISSING_ASSESSMENT_COVERAGE: Lesson content exists but no question/assertion tests this LP's required application type.
categoryDefinitions.MISSING_OR_UNSUITABLE_VISUAL: A diagram/visual this LP depends on does not exist, or an existing one is technically wrong per the governed evidence.
categoryDefinitions.OBSOLETE_SHOULD_REMOVE: The runtime corpus teaches something this LP's topic area that the governed curriculum has explicitly retired, corrected, or found unsupported.
categoryDefinitions.CONTEXTUAL_DEFERRED: This LP is DEFERRED_CONTEXT_ONLY/CONTEXTUAL_SUPPORT_ONLY in the governed curriculum; runtime correctly treats it as non-assessable/absent.
categoryDefinitions.RETIRED: This LP is RETIRED_OUT_OF_SCOPE; runtime correctly omits it.

productionDeltaSummary.newLessonContentNeeded: 43 learning points have zero runtime teaching content -- the largest single category, dominated by Batch 01 (24 of 25 foundational-mathematics LPs exist only as unused knowledge-graph prerequisite nodes, never taught or tested standalone).
productionDeltaSummary.depthCorrectionNeeded: 29 learning points have some runtime content but at the wrong depth -- both under-depth (missing a required nuance, e.g. EDA-LP-09's PTC Curie-point qualification, EQCT-LP-16's capacitor-discharge caveat) and over-depth/scope-creep (MM-LP-14 teaches the excluded KE=1/2 m v^2 calculation; EQCT-LP-13 teaches the excluded Z=sqrt(R^2+X^2) phasor calculation; EMI-LP-14 corpus separately teaches Faraday's law quantitatively beyond this batch's scope).
productionDeltaSummary.newAssessmentItemsNeeded: 4 learning points have teaching content but no assessment reaching the required application type.
productionDeltaSummary.obsoleteContentToRemoveOrCorrect: 2 learning points (both in Batch 06: EDA-LP-25, EDA-LP-28) have runtime content that is LIVE, ACTIVELY ASSESSED, and directly contradicts the governed evidence review's explicit retirement/exclusion of the same claim -- see safetyFindings. This is the single most safety-relevant finding of this mapping and should be prioritised over any other production-delta item.
productionDeltaSummary.visualsAssessment: Visual coverage is generally strong where lesson content already exists (series/parallel topology, instrument connections, lever/gear/pulley diagrams, motional-EMF geometry all pass semantic-audit contracts) and is not the primary bottleneck. Known exceptions: EDA-LP-16's deterministic component-symbols renderer draws LED/inverter/LDR symbols with more confidence than the governed evidence currently supports; EDA-LP-17's 11 physical-appearance photo assets are produced but not wired into the shipped app; EMI-LP-02's straight-conductor field-pattern hybrid image has no semantic-audit contract entry; EMI-LP-06 (solenoid) has no visual asset of any kind.
productionDeltaSummary.contentAheadOfEvidence: EMI-LP-16 (Fleming's right-hand rule): the runtime corpus teaches, as settled fact, the exact thumb/field/current finger mapping the governed evidence pipeline could not verify from any permitted-class source after multiple genuine re-sourcing attempts -- sourced instead to a general encyclopedia article. This is not a factual error (the mapping is almost certainly correct) but is content whose confidence in the runtime exceeds what the governed evidence review currently supports, and should be reconciled (either accept the encyclopedia-tier source into the governed evidence with disclosure, or flag the runtime claim as provisional) rather than left silently mismatched.
productionDeltaSummary.overallFraming: This mapping confirms the user's own framing exactly: the governed 133-point curriculum-definition input finishing (this pass's work) is a distinct and substantially smaller achievement than the learner-facing Unit 202 course/app being finished. The old runtime corpus (24 lessons historically reported) was authored before, and independently of, this governed evidence-acquisition pipeline, and only partially and unevenly overlaps with it.
